summary: Opened this run's audit of the captured hashicorp/raft snapshot and registered the concrete finding that, with RestoreCommittedLogs enabled, NewRaft's configuration scan starts at max(snapshotIndex,lastApplied)+1 while restoreFromCommittedLogs has just set lastApplied to the recovered commit index, so committed configuration entries at or below that index are never loaded; a queued experiment restarts a commit-tracking single-node cluster (no-snapshot and snapshot+AddNonvoter variants) to capture the scan range, lastApplied, the committed config entry and the post-restart configuration. Formal comparison declarations still need mode-based setup events with distinct admission aliases, and the interpretation is conditional until the retained receipt replaces the local construction feedback.
